note: Dixie County's official zoning atlas is published only as a static PDF (DIZN13.pdf) on the NCFRPC site. The county's ArcGIS map (DixieMapData FeatureServer, used by the dixie-ems Dixie Map app) has 46 layers, none of them zoning districts. Municode Article 4 gives the district text but no GIS service. A search for Cross City or Horseshoe Beach zoning GIS found nothing queryable.
